'''Edruu''' was the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When embarrassing holos of Edruu were anonymously transmitted across the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] put out a substantial reward to whoever could find the culprit; it turned out to be [[Edruu's father|Edruu's own father]], who hoped to teach his son humility.<ref name="PoF" />
